description: Keyframe ORDERING document-invariant contract (accept/reject parity): within one channel, keyframes must be STRICTLY sorted by timeUs — ascending, no duplicates. Consumed by packages/timeline-schema/tests/invariants.test.ts (zod validateTimelineDoc) and backend/tests/VideoEdit.UnitTests/KeyframeOrderParityTests.cs (ExportCompiler.Validate -> KeyframeCompiler.Parse). Both runners exercise every case on a visual channel (opacity) AND the audio channel (volume), mirroring keyframe-bounds-vectors.json. Every timeUs sits inside [0, timelineDurationUs] and every timelineDurationUs sits on the 30fps project frame grid, so ONLY the ordering rule separates valid from invalid — the bounds rule has its own vector file and must not fire here. This closes the 'keyframe siralamasi' family of the document-invariant parity gap recorded in docs/backlog.md (14. tur, M3 sinifi — same class as C1).
